observations.expected: One continuous straight radiopaque rod projects across the thorax.
observations.observed: A single, continuous, straight, highly radiopaque rod is visible traversing the lower thorax from the right lateral chest wall through to the left side, with a pointed tip visible on the left. The rod is uniform in density and uninterrupted across its entire visible length.

observations.expected: The visible ribs, clavicles and spine are coherent without duplicated bones.
observations.observed: Both clavicles are individually identifiable and appear symmetric without duplication. The spine is midline and coherent from the cervical-thoracic junction through the visible thoracic levels. Rib pairs are symmetric and trace normal arcs bilaterally without forking, floating, or extra ribs. No duplicated bony structures are identified.
